answer_1.quote: We empirically compare the proposed method with a wide range of baselines... The task of attribute‑controllable text generation ... sentiment control and toxicity avoidance ...
datasets: Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation. We test the generated texts from three aspects. (1) Attribute Relevance... (2) Fluency... (3) Diversity...

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation from three aspects. Relevance reflects the degree of achievement for the desired control attribute. Topicality means whether the generated continuations are consistent with the given prompts. Fluency evaluates the text's fluency from the human perspective.
answer_4.guideline: Five expert annotators score each sample on a 0‑10 scale for relevance, topicality, and fluency.
